scope.required_future_comparison: Any token-coupling result must exceed this raw measurement-layer association under matched splits and null controls.

data_contract.feature_selection_rule: No validation measurement or association may select or alter features, bands, lags, sign, aggregation, or null family.

cell_and_unit_contract.trial_pairing: Spearman correlation across paired trial indices within each cell
cell_and_unit_contract.aggregation: Fisher z within cell, then equal weight across cells within subject, then equal weight across subjects within split
cell_and_unit_contract.missingness: A cell-feature-lag is excluded if fewer than 8 finite paired trials remain; exclusions and effective counts are reported.

feature_contract.eeg_channels: all six channels supplied by the frozen R1-P raw view; equal channel weights

eeg_preprocessing.bandpower: sum of spectral power at bins within inclusive band edges
eeg_preprocessing.channel_aggregation: arithmetic mean of six channel log-bandpowers

feature_contract.fnirs_channel_contract: R1-P raw registry channels must map unambiguously to HbO and HbR; otherwise formal analysis fails closed.

lag_contract.valid_source_patches: source patch indices for which source_index + lag < 10
lag_contract.same_trial_pairing: EEG and lagged fNIRS features come from the same trial before null permutation.

primary_estimand.name: registered_alpha_HbO_negative_association_positive_lag_auc
primary_estimand.sign_alignment: multiply Fisher z by -1 so larger values indicate stronger registered coupling
primary_estimand.auc_definition: trapezoidal integral of the split-level subject-equal Fisher-z curve over lag seconds 2,4,6,8,10, divided by the 8-second integration width
primary_estimand.inference: one-sided permutation p-value from the same sign-aligned AUC null

diagnostic_family.members: all 3 EEG bands x 2 fNIRS chromophores x 5 lags
diagnostic_family.multiplicity: single-step max-stat permutation FWER within each split across all 30 members
diagnostic_family.selection: No diagnostic may replace or redefine the registered primary.

null_contract.operation: independently permute fNIRS trial labels within each subject x session x condition cell, applying one permutation jointly to all fNIRS patches and both chromophores
null_contract.null_storage: compressed NPZ containing primary AUC and 30-member max-stat null distributions for train and validation separately

synthetic_acceptance_tests: known delayed alpha-HbO trial pairing produces a larger registered AUC than its permutation null
within-cell permutation preserves every fNIRS trial time course and marginal but changes pairing
max-stat adjusted p-values control the declared 30-member family and are never smaller than unadjusted member p-values
protected subject identifiers cause a fail-closed error before array dereference
validation cannot modify the frozen feature contract
